plan.title: **Scaffold parity verification test structure**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Replace Harness-based frame generation with `reference_frame()` calls. Add test setup for generating light and dark mode reference frames using the embedded font pair. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::reference_frames_generate_successfully -- --nocapture` passes, outputs frame dimensions.

plan.title: **Verify reference frames are deterministic**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Add test that generates the same frame twice and compares pixel buffers. Ensure `reference_frame()` produces byte-for-byte identical output on repeated calls. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::reference_frames_are_deterministic` passes with no output.

plan.title: **Assert all pixels are opaque (canvas requirement)**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Add test verifying every pixel in light and dark frames has alpha == 0xFF. This gate catches regressions where partial transparency leaks into the render, which would fail browser comparison. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::all_pixels_are_opaque` passes.

plan.title: **Verify light and dark frames differ**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Add test asserting light mode pixels != dark mode pixels. Catches regressions where appearance is ignored. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::light_and_dark_differ` passes.

plan.title: **Collect parity frame dimensions for canvas setup**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Store `REFERENCE_WIDTH` and `REFERENCE_HEIGHT` as module constants matching demo.rs. Add test extracting canvas dimensions from rendered frame and verifying they match expected constants. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::frame_dimensions_match_reference` passes.

plan.title: **Add pixel-byte count verification**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Add test verifying frame pixel buffer size matches `width * height * 4` bytes (RGBA). Ensures image::rgba() encoding is correct. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::pixel_buffer_size_is_correct` passes.

plan.title: **Build both appearances and store bytes for CI gate**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Create `fn parity_frames() -> [(Appearance, Vec<u8>); 2]` helper returning light and dark pixel buffers. Add integration test that calls it and verifies both frames exist and are non-empty. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::parity_frames_available` passes.

plan.title: **Refactor test file to use reference_frame() instead of Harness**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Remove Harness-based rendering, temp directory writes. Keep only deterministic reference_frame() calls with embedded fonts. Simplify test assertions to pixel-level comparisons. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity` passes, no temp files written.

plan.title: **Add explicit light/dark parity gate test**
plan.body: `tests/wasm_parity.rs` — Create `#[test] fn parity_light_and_dark_verified()` that generates both frames, compares to known expected properties (opaque, differing, correct size). This is the final CI gate. Acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity::parity_light_and_dark_verified` passes.

plan.title: **Run full parity test suite locally**
plan.body: Command line — Execute `cargo test --test wasm_parity` and verify all tests pass. Confirms no regressions in rendering, determinism, or frame generation. Acceptance: All 9 tests pass, zero failures, no output anomalies.

plan.title: **Verify wasm_parity test integrates with CI**
plan.body: Command line — Run `cargo test --test wasm_parity` as part of `cargo test` suite. Confirm test appears in standard test output. Acceptance: `cargo test 2>&1 | grep -c "wasm_parity"` shows ≥ 9 tests.
